# Environment variables and command line

> Generated from the code by `scripts/generate-docs-reference.ts`. Do not edit this file: change the code and run `npm run docs:reference`.

`india-subscriptions serve` is configured only through environment variables. A variable that is unset or blank counts as absent. A gateway is enabled when its required variables are all present; setting only some of them is an error, never a silently disabled gateway. Error messages name the variable and the rule and never contain a value.

## Service

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INDIA_SUBSCRIPTIONS_API_KEY` | yes, unless you pass `--allow-unauthenticated` |  | Bearer token clients must send (Authorization: Bearer ...). Required unless you start with --allow-unauthenticated. |
| `HOST` | no | `127.0.0.1` | Interface to listen on; the default is loopback only. Use 0.0.0.0 deliberately. |
| `PORT` | no | `8787` | Port to listen on (0 picks a free one). |

## Razorpay

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` | yes |  | API key id (the checkout "key"). |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` | yes |  | API key secret. |
| `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | no |  | Webhook secret from the Razorpay dashboard; without it Razorpay webhooks are rejected. |
| `RAZORPAY_DEFAULT_DURATION_YEARS` | no |  | Optional: length in years of a "bill until cancelled" subscription (1-100, default 10). |
| `RAZORPAY_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces https://api.razorpay.com (a proxy or mock server). |

## Cashfree

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CASHFREE_CLIENT_ID` | yes |  | Cashfree app id (x-client-id). |
| `CASHFREE_CLIENT_SECRET` | yes |  | Cashfree secret key (x-client-secret). |
| `CASHFREE_ENVIRONMENT` | yes |  | test (sandbox) or live (real money). |
| `CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | no |  | Optional: secret that signs webhooks; defaults to the client secret. |
| `CASHFREE_API_VERSION` | no |  | Optional: x-api-version as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the version the adapter was built for. |
| `CASHFREE_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the Cashfree host, including the /pg prefix (a proxy or mock server). |

## PayU

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PAYU_KEY` | yes |  | PayU merchant key. |
| `PAYU_SALT` | yes |  | PayU merchant salt. |
| `PAYU_ENVIRONMENT` | yes |  | test (test.payu.in) or live (secure.payu.in). |
| `PAYU_SUCCESS_URL` | no |  | Optional: default success return URL (surl) for subscriptions without a returnUrl. |
| `PAYU_FAILURE_URL` | no |  | Optional: default failure return URL (furl); falls back to the success URL. |
| `PAYU_CONSENT_HASH_LAYOUT` | no |  | Optional: consent hash layout, one of six_pipes (default), five_pipes, four_pipes; change only if PayU rejects the hash. |
| `PAYU_ACCEPT_UNSIGNED_WEBHOOKS` | no |  | Optional: true to normalise PayU's unsigned cancellation/refund webhooks; only behind an IP allow-list for PayU. |
| `PAYU_PAYMENT_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the PayU _payment URL (a proxy or mock server). |
| `PAYU_API_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the PayU postservice URL, including ?form=2 (a proxy or mock server). |

## PhonePe

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PHONEPE_CLIENT_ID` | yes |  | PhonePe Business Dashboard client id (Developer Settings). |
| `PHONEPE_CLIENT_SECRET` | yes |  | PhonePe client secret. |
| `PHONEPE_CLIENT_VERSION` | yes |  | The client version issued with the credentials (a number such as 1, or text). |
| `PHONEPE_ENVIRONMENT` | yes |  | test (PhonePe sandbox/UAT) or live (production). |
| `PHONEPE_WEBHOOK_USERNAME` | yes |  | Webhook username from the dashboard ("SHA (Username & Password)"); set with the password, or PhonePe webhooks are rejected. |
| `PHONEPE_WEBHOOK_PASSWORD` | yes |  | Webhook password; set together with the username. |
| `PHONEPE_REDIRECT_URL` | no |  | Optional: default redirect URL for subscriptions without a returnUrl. |
| `PHONEPE_API_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the PhonePe PG host (a proxy or mock server). |
| `PHONEPE_TOKEN_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the PhonePe OAuth token URL (a proxy or mock server). |

## Paytm

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PAYTM_MID` | yes |  | Paytm merchant id (different for staging and production). |
| `PAYTM_MERCHANT_KEY` | yes |  | Paytm merchant key: exactly 16 bytes, the AES key of Paytm's checksum (also verifies webhooks). |
| `PAYTM_WEBSITE` | yes |  | websiteName: WEBSTAGING on staging, DEFAULT on production, or the name Paytm gave you. |
| `PAYTM_ENVIRONMENT` | yes |  | test (staging hosts) or live (production hosts). |
| `PAYTM_CALLBACK_URL` | no |  | Optional: default callback URL for subscriptions without a returnUrl. |
| `PAYTM_CHANNEL_ID` | no |  | Optional: head.channelId of the Theia-style APIs, WEB or WAP (omitted by default). |
| `PAYTM_CLIENT_ID` | no |  | Optional: head.clientId, only for merchants with more than one key. |
| `PAYTM_GRACE_DAYS` | no |  | Optional: subscriptionGraceDays for merchant-collected subscriptions (0-365; default derived from the schedule). |
| `PAYTM_RETRY_COUNT` | no |  | Optional: subscriptionRetryCount for merchant-collected subscriptions (1-10, default 3). |
| `PAYTM_MANDATE_YEARS` | no |  | Optional: years a subscription without an end date stays valid (1-30, default 5). |
| `PAYTM_DEBIT_REASON` | no |  | Optional: reason shown in the pre-debit notification (at most 50 characters, default "Subscription renewal"). |
| `PAYTM_SUBSCRIPTION_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the Paytm subscription-service host (a proxy or mock server). |
| `PAYTM_TRANSACTION_STATUS_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the Paytm Transaction Status API host. |
| `PAYTM_REFUND_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the Paytm Refund API host. |
| `PAYTM_CHECKOUT_BASE_URL` | no |  | Optional: replaces the host customers are sent to for authorisation. |

## Billing scheduler

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCHEDULER_STORE_FILE` | no |  | Path of the scheduler's state file (one JSON file, one service instance only). Unset: the scheduler is off and gateways that need it (merchant-scheduled mandates) refuse to create subscriptions. |
| `SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS` | no | `300` | Seconds between scheduler ticks (1-86400, default 300). |

## Events webhook

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EVENTS_WEBHOOK_URL` | yes |  | Where to POST events as JSON. Gateway webhook events ({"kind":"gateway","provider":...,"events":[...]}) are sent before the gateway is answered: a non-2xx answer makes the gateway retry. Billing scheduler events ({"kind":"scheduler","events":[...]}, only with SCHEDULER_STORE_FILE) are sent in the background, retried with backoff 5 times, then logged and dropped. Every event has an "id": de-duplicate on it (delivery is at least once). |
| `EVENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | yes |  | Shared secret. Each POST carries two headers: x-india-subscriptions-timestamp: Unix time in whole seconds, e.g. 1767225600 x-india-subscriptions-signature: lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 (key = this secret) of the string &lt;timestamp> "." &lt;raw request body> e.g. 1767225600.{"kind":"scheduler","events":[...]} A receiver recomputes it over the exact bytes received, compares in constant time, and rejects a timestamp that is missing, not a number, or more than 300 seconds from its clock (past or future). TypeScript receivers can call verifyEventsSignature() from india-subscriptions. |

## Limits

`SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS` accepts 1 to 86400. `PORT` accepts 0 to 65535 (0 picks a free port).

## Command line

```text
india-subscriptions 0.1.0

Usage:
  india-subscriptions serve [--allow-unauthenticated]
  india-subscriptions openapi [--server-url <url>]
  india-subscriptions --help | --version

Commands:
  serve     Run the HTTP service (OpenAPI at /v1/openapi.json). Configured only
            through environment variables; see .env.example in the package.
  openapi   Print the service's OpenAPI 3.1 document as JSON and exit.

Options:
  --allow-unauthenticated   serve: accept requests without an API key. Without
                            it INDIA_SUBSCRIPTIONS_API_KEY is required.
  --server-url <url>        openapi: where the API is mounted (default "/").
  -h, --help                Show this help.
  -v, --version             Show the version.

Environment (serve):
  INDIA_SUBSCRIPTIONS_API_KEY   bearer token clients must send
  HOST, PORT                   listen address (default 127.0.0.1:8787)
  Gateways, each enabled by its variables (a half-set gateway is an error):
    RAZORPAY_KEY_ID RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET [RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET]
    CASHFREE_CLIENT_ID CASHFREE_CLIENT_SECRET CASHFREE_ENVIRONMENT [CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_SECRET]
    PAYU_KEY PAYU_SALT PAYU_ENVIRONMENT [PAYU_SUCCESS_URL PAYU_FAILURE_URL]
  SCHEDULER_STORE_FILE, SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS   billing scheduler (off without a store file)
  EVENTS_WEBHOOK_URL, EVENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET   forward gateway events, signed
```
